name: Starship Damage Location
description: p.86. Roll 2D when a ship is hit to determine the hit location. Called shots: a gunner can choose to attack a specific location but incurs -2DM (the Gunner action "Select Target Location" on p.85 gives -4DM). Each hit decreases the system by one step.

name: Small Craft Hit Location
description: p.86. Roll 1D to determine the hit location on a small craft.

name: Starship Internal Damage
description: p.87. Roll D3 each time the Internal area of a ship is hit to determine what is impacted. When Internal reaches 0 hits remaining, the interior depressurizes; any additional hit counts against the hull.

results.text: Computer: Every hit decreases the amount of programs capable of functioning by 1.

Crew injury: All crew members on board attempt to roll 8+ to avoid damage, but add their END mod and any -1DM from the Internal damage. Anyone in a low berth needs a 8+ to avoid the berth shorting out, but even if it does, it can be repaired. Referees can choose to roll a D3 and apply it to all NPCs on board as automatic damage taken, to streamline resolution.

Cargo hold: To determine if the cargo hold is damaged, roll 8+ to determine if damage was avoided. On a failed roll, the difference is multiplied by 10% to determine how much cargo was damaged. For example if a 6 was rolled then 20% of the cargo was damaged.
